scope: SELECT scalar emission in the three dialects and the native predicate dispatch that reaches it.
admittedForms: One typed operand and a sequence of positive instanceof early-return branches
A final match(true) with an explicit instanceof arm for each remaining concrete role
For native predicates a terminal call to the previously checked scalar method with the same narrowed input
negativeControls: Remove an explicitly typed scalar branch from an admitted operand role
Add a fallback that silently swallows an unhandled role
Narrow the scalar method signature and dispatch together while a checked caller field can still contain the removed role
proofLimit: This check establishes dispatch coverage for the typed argument and the listed caller edges. The SQL body semantics and availability of referenced slots are separate obligations.
trust: Resolved PHP AST, closed immutable-field evidence, and the fixed role-specific SQL body checks.
